title: C3PA: An Open Dataset of Expert-Annotated and Regulation-Aware Privacy Policies to Enable Scalable Regulatory Compliance Audits
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and legal task of automating privacy policy compliance audits according to the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). While privacy has ethical dimensions, the paper itself is a benchmarking and dataset paper for regulatory compliance, not a study or benchmark of religion, faith, morals, or philosophical ethics.
